about: Every TrellisWM reference item (T..) and Arbor-only feature (A..), with Arbor's status and the tests and real-window steps that prove it. Statuses: shipped, partial, review (finished on a branch), in-progress, planned (has a spec), missing (no spec yet), not-planned. Priority 1 = core, 2 = important, 3 = nice to have. kind=policy means there is nothing to test. `make parity` turns this into docs/FEATURES.md.

features.title: One 460 ms layout motion
features.trellis: Every split, dock and close animates; camera moves zoom the whole plane
features.arbor: One ease-out of `animationDuration` (0.46 s; 0 or Reduce motion turns it off) for every camera move, dock, float, close, minimize and resize by command. Camera moves zoom the whole plane. A second command carries on from where things are. A correction, when an app had the last word on its frame, ends when the motion was going to. What a motion needs is got ready ahead of time, so the first one after a start begins as promptly as the next. Windows travel as their app's colour and icon, not their contents (T53). Filmed on a Mac at 1.2 s only: that run's 0.46 s session crashed, in the pictures that are now switched off

features.arbor: Hold This View; `hold [minutes]`, `release`, `toggle-hold`: nothing moves the view, windows out of view stay there, rules wait; it never widens by itself, its end moves nothing, and ⌃⌥⎋ releases

features.title: Hold still during calls
features.arbor: Hold Still; `hold still [minutes]`: the view moves only when asked, and what is turned away is said on screen. By itself while a camera or a microphone is on or a window in `holdStillFor` is open, if switched on: all three ship off until seen at work on a Mac

features.title: Go to…: find any window, named space or saved view by typing
features.arbor: ⌃⌥G; `find [text]`, `reveal [window]`. Most recently used first; brings back minimised, hidden and tabbed windows. The palette has come and gone on a Mac; no key pressed in it, no picture looked at yet
e2e: find a window by its title
open Go to…
close Go to…
bring the minimised window back
bring a window of the hidden app back

features.title: Options per display
features.arbor: `displays` in settings.json: a display's own gap, tile size and screen edge band, by name, UUID, width, `main` or `builtin`; `arborctl displays`

features.title: Events for scripts and status bars
features.arbor: `arborctl watch` streams the view (in words too), layout, focus, windows and their state, displays, settings, pause and resume as lines of JSON; titles only on request; `docs/SCRIPTING.md`
e2e: start watching events
what the watcher heard
the watcher is told that Arbor quit

features.title: Shortcuts that macOS uses as well are pointed out
features.arbor: `bindings` and the log list each shortcut macOS has ticked for itself (⌃⌥Space with several input sources), by key, on any layout, and say where to change either

features.title: Says on screen what happened
features.arbor: A line low on the display after a shortcut, gesture or menu item: why nothing happened, what changed unseen, three hints for newcomers three times each; `messages`: helpful, all, off

features.title: The shortcuts on screen
features.arbor: ⌃⌥⇧/; `show-shortcuts`; Keyboard Shortcuts… in the menu: the shortcuts in effect by name, grouped as the help is; any key, click or command puts them away
e2e: show the shortcuts on screen
put the shortcuts away

features.title: One switch for every event tap
features.arbor: `pointerGestures`, "Trackpad and mouse gestures" in the settings window: off, Arbor installs no event tap, whatever the pinch's, the scroll's and the rectangle's own settings say; keys, the menu and dragging windows stay. It ships off (Q26)
